title: Canadian Grand Prix
metaDescription: Canadian Grand Prix: source-backed dates, circuit and visitor planning for this Formula 1 race.

overview.about: The Canadian Grand Prix has been held on the Circuit Gilles-Villeneuve - a semi-permanent track on Ile Notre-Dame in the St Lawrence River - since 1978, and it consistently delivers drama. Long straights, heavy braking zones and the infamous 'Wall of Champions' at the final chicane make it a favourite of drivers and a reliable producer of surprises. Michael Schumacher and Lewis Hamilton share the record with seven wins each. The 2027 race is on 11-13 June.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 Canadian Grand Prix runs 11-13 June in Montreal. The circuit's low-grip surface and long flat-out sections are hard on brakes and engines, and its position beside the river makes it one of the most scenic stops on the calendar.

@graph.description: The Canadian Grand Prix is Formula 1’s Montréal round, held at Circuit Gilles-Villeneuve on Île Notre-Dame. The race first joined the World Championship in 1967 and has been staged in Montréal since 1978. Its semi-permanent island circuit uses heavy braking zones, chicanes and close barriers, a combination that makes track position and precision especially important. The existing OneSliders event page supplies the edition dates through Event JSON-LD; this record keeps those stated dates instead of estimating a calendar move. Practice, qualifying and the Grand Prix make up the essential Formula 1 programme, and the organiser’s own guidance remains the source for session times, tickets and access.
